title: Attack on Titan
source: Attack on Titan manga by Hajime Isayama (139 chapters), to the final chapter.
world: Humanity lives inside three giant walls on the island of Paradis, hiding from man-eating Titans. Eren Yeager, Mikasa Ackerman and Armin Arlert join the Survey Corps after the Colossal Titan breaks the wall. They learn the walls hide a bigger world: the nation of Marley, the Eldian people who can turn into Titans, and a cycle of war and hatred. The story ends with the Rumbling and Eren's death. Grim, political and emotional.
power_system: Nine Titan Shifters (Attack, Founding, Colossal, Armored, Female, Beast, Jaw, Cart, War Hammer) can transform; the power is passed on by being eaten. Shifters live only thirteen years after inheriting. Soldiers fight Titans with vertical manoeuvring (ODM) gear, aiming for the nape.
